refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: From `npx nanit-auth`. The plugin stores rotated tokens itself, so this is only needed for first setup or after the token is revoked.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh camera list and sensor data (in seconds)

streamMode.title: Stream Mode
streamMode.description: auto: local, falling back to cloud. local: the camera publishes straight to Homebridge over the LAN. cloud: stream from Nanit's servers.

localRtmpPort.title: Local RTMP Port
localRtmpPort.description: Port of the RTMP server cameras publish to in local/auto mode.

localAddress.title: Local Address
localAddress.description: Optional: Override the automatically detected host IP for local streaming
